watch.en: Stir the starch smooth in a little cool liquid, add it to the hot liquid and heat almost to the boil, stirring.
watch.de: Die Stärke in etwas kalter Flüssigkeit glatt rühren, zur heißen Flüssigkeit geben und unter Rühren fast zum Kochen bringen.

why.en: The cool liquid keeps the starch grains apart so they do not lump; starch thickens once it is heated almost to boiling.
why.de: Die kalte Flüssigkeit hält die Stärkekörner auseinander, damit sie nicht klumpen; Stärke bindet, sobald sie fast zum Kochen erhitzt ist.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces, and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 1.3 Sauces and Thickening Agents, section Incorporating Cornstarch
sources.sentence: Cornstarch must be mixed with a cool liquid before it is introduced into a hot one.

sources.title: Flavors of the Saucier: Stocks, Sauces, and Soups (Zeringue and Thibodeaux)
sources.place: chapter 1.3 Sauces and Thickening Agents, section Incorporating Cornstarch
sources.sentence: The cool liquid separates the grains of starch and allows them to begin absorbing liquid without lumping.

sources.sentence: Starches must be combined with liquid and heated almost to boiling to be effective.
